name: good-fit-section
title: Good fit section
description: Who it suits and who it does not: two honest columns that save the wrong customers and reassure the right ones.
docs: Pass title, fit and notFit (four to six short lines each), alternative (the line and its href) and cta (a label and an href). Two columns sit on one bordered surface under "A good fit if" with checks and "Probably not if" with dashes; the second is tinted so it reads as the quieter one. The action sits under the first list and, under the second, a line points to what to use instead; the whole line is the link when you give an href. Both lists are real lists under real headings, and the check and dash icons repeat what the headings already say, so they are hidden from assistive technology. Under 768px of width the columns stack with the good fit first. align centres the heading; labels translates the two column heads.
